item.text: {"diagnosis":"Repeated actions are overrepresented in candidate/bad runs.","expected_mechanism":"Detecting unchanged action-target-state attempts and requiring a changed approach should prevent unproductive loops, improving task progress. The cost is extra state tracking and occasional premature switching when repetition is legitimately necessary.","policy_text":"Before repeating an action on the same target, compare the relevant observable state with the prior attempt. If it is unchanged, do not repeat unchanged more than once; instead change the action, target, parameters, or strategy, or stop and report the blocker.","quantitative_evidence":[{"command":"jq -s '{candidate_total:(map(select(.value>0)|.value)|add),candidate_repeated:(map(select(.value>0 and .stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\")|.value)|add),base_total:(map(select(.value<0)|-.value)|add),base_repeated:(map(select(.value<0 and .stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\")|-.value)|add)} | . + {candidate_rate:(.candidate_repeated/.candidate_total),base_rate:(.base_repeated/.base_total),rate_ratio:((.candidate_repeated/.candidate_total)/(.base_repeated/.base_total)),net_excess:(.candidate_repeated-.base_repeated)}' samples.jsonl","finding":"Candidate/bad runs contain 1,485 repeated operations out of 7,366 (20.16%); base/good runs contain 224 out of 3,780 (5.93%). Repetition is 3.40× as prevalent, with +1,261 candidate operations."},{"command":"jq -s 'map(select(.stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\")) | {candidate_distinct_sessions:(map(select(.value>0)|.labels.source_session[0])|unique|length),base_distinct_sessions:(map(select(.value<0)|.labels.source_session[0])|unique|length),candidate_count:(map(select(.value>0)|.value)|add),base_count:(map(select(.value<0)|-.value)|add)}' samples.jsonl","finding":"Repeated operations occur across 88 distinct candidate/bad source sessions versus 20 base/good sessions, showing recurrence rather than a single-run anomaly."}]}
